subject.scene_narrative: A pair of hands guides a peer through a math problem, pencil pointing at a hand-drawn parabola curve on an open notebook while a ruler steadies the page. A protractor and a small teal sticky note with an encouraging squiggle sit nearby, capturing the warmth of a one-on-one study session rather than a stiff lecture.
